main_text.p: Quintus Marci peculium confecutus est: ea ex parte Marcus quod insuper soluit, condicet(nimirum in themate noftro quinquaginta) quippe quū ea tantū ex parte naturalis obligatio sub lata fit. Et quemadmodum Vlpian. fcribit in l.1. §.4. D. quarum rerum exceptio non datur, (fic enim illum emē do tit.nisi forte Exactio legi debeat) non poteft libertus oneratum fe queri, fi lucrum abreptum ex re patroni non faciat: fimiliter non poteft Quintus iure de Marco queri, fi lucrum ex ipsius peculio contra naturae legem abreptum nō faciat. Hanc autem enū ciationem, quod fcilicet naturalis obligatio, qua ex parte peculiū participatum eft, tollitur, argumento gemino ex minori ducto confirmat: tametfi u-nam tantum ex eo conclusionem eliciat. Finge(inquit) Marcum Hortenfio extraneo uiginti debuiffe, centum autem in peculio habuiffe, patre mortuo, Quintus frater ex Marci peculio quinquaginta confecutus eft. Hortenfius poteft agere actione de peculio contra Quintum, & decem ab eo exigere.

page.notes: Running head is set in heavy, blurred type and cannot be read; its length is estimated. A small mark at the top right (an "f") is not text and was left out. Spelling is as printed: "emē do tit." is uncertain. Long s has been written as s throughout, so forms such as "debuisse" and "poteft" appear as printed with s. The line "tametfi u-" / "nam" is broken at the line end with its printed hyphen.
